connector.name: GotFreeFax
connector.registryDescription: Send free or paid faxes to US/Canada from Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI agents.
connector.summary: Hosted at gotfreefax.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.gotfreefax, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional Bearer token: 'Bearer ' + base64(account_number + ':' + pin). Required for paid tools.
